t.name: Sleeping Beauty Trail #37
t.description: The trail zigzags up through forest and over bare rock to the old fire lookout site, affording excellent views of Trout Lake valley and the surrounding peaks.

t.name: Filloon Trail #102
t.description: Filloon Trail provides access to Indian Heaven Wilderness from Little Goose Horse Camp.

t.name: Wapiki Lake Trail #34A
t.description: This trail traverses a timbered hillside to Lake Wapiki, part of Lemei Rock's old crater.

t.name: Lemei Trail #34
t.description: This 5.3 mile trail offers views of Mounts Adams, Rainier, St. Helens, and Hood, along with views of Lemei Rock, a 5,925' promontory that juts 500' above Lake Wapiki.

t.name: Steamboat Lake Trail #70
t.description: This 0.5 mile trail follows the northern edge of Steamboat Lake to the Pacific Crest National Scenic Trail #2000.

t.name: Langfield Falls Trail #8
t.description: The trail parallels Mosquito Creek to a vantage point where a monument to former ranger K.C. Langfield is erected, with the beautiful Langfield Falls as a background.

t.name: Peeled Cedar Trail #15
t.description: This short trail site offers a flat, gravel surface that wanders through an old growth forest offering a plethera of huge Cedar and Douglas Firs. It also includes a standing peeled cedar tree with a interpretive sign.

t.name: Steamboat Viewpoint Trail #14
t.description: A short 0.5 mile pleasant trail with wildflowers in season that climbs to the top of Steamboat Mountain, a former fire lookout site, with an intertesting view of the summit of Mt. Adams.
